IncidentPayload.title: IncidentPayload
IncidentPayload.description: Validation Rules - `fire_details` only possible if at least one `FIRE` incident type is present. - `hazsit_details` only possible if at least one `HAZSIT` incident type is present. - `medical_details` only possible if at least one `MEDICAL` incident type is present. - Incidents with a `FIRE||STRUCTURE_FIRE` type require fire suppression and alarm modules: `smoke_alarm`, `fire_alarm`, `other_alarm`, `fire_suppression`, unless all aids are `SUPPORT_AID` that was `GIVEN` to another department. - Incidents with a `FIRE||STRUCTURE_FIRE||CONFINED_COOKING_APPLIANCE_FIRE` type require the `cooking_fire_suppression` module, unless all aids are `SUPPORT_AID` that was `GIVEN` to another department. - Only one `incident_type` can be marked with `primary` as `true`. - `aids.department_neris_id` cannot be the same as `base.department_neris_id`. - `aids.department_neris_id` values must be unique. - `incident_types.type` values must be unique.
